name: aa-sites
description: AA emplacements on foot as two-part installations (exposed deck + bunker): a zone.describeRoom panel on each aa_sites deck tile showing the battery's name, faction, and live status (MANNED / ● FIRING / OFF-LINE UNDER REPAIR / cold ruin), a throttled room broadcast when the guns open up (flight.aaFired), and the repair loop — a strafed battery (active=0) is brought back online by its sheltered bunker engineer after REPAIR_MS, unless the engineer is dead. Exposed gunners are stationed NPCs; the engineer is flagged aa_engineer. Emits flight.aaRepaired.
